{{Top|leg}}
'''Gamma-class''' was a rating given to cuisine and accommodations to indicate its level of luxury. The food and accommodations at ''[[Castle Bocce]]'' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] were considered to be of Gamma-class quality.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
